texts.04788bd7b0da: The data supplied by the NHS IC to Addenbrooke's Hospital will be used only for the approved Medical Research Project MR 1098.
texts.089045691241: Cardiovascular disease is now a leading cause of death worldwide,with myocardial Infarction and stroke accounting for over 20% of deaths. as we get older our arteries stiffen .this leads to an increase in blood pressure and places us at greater risk of strokes and heart attacks.Although we know that arteries stiffen with age , we don't know the precise rate of stiffening, or whether arteries stiffen more quickly the older we become. This is a prospective longitudinal follow up study of a large cohort of individuals to measure the rate of arterial stiffening in healthy individuals and to investigate the factors which influence arterial stiffness and a number of other key parameters which will be assessed at baseline and re-assessed after one and five years.
